FIELDS.NAME: Dreamy Duvets & Blissful Bedding
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Dreamy Duvets & Blissful Bedding, we specialize in the retail of high-quality bath and bedding products. Our operations are centered around providing a wide range of linens, towels, comforters, and accessories designed to enhance the comfort and aesthetics of our customers' homes. We pride ourselves on sourcing our products exclusively from reputable domestic suppliers, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and quality control standards. 

Our store features a well-organized layout that encourages customers to explore our diverse offerings, while our trained staff are equipped to assist with product selection and provide excellent customer service. To safeguard our inventory and prevent loss, we conduct regular inventory audits and maintain comprehensive documentation for all transactions. High-value items are secured in locked display cases, and our premises are equipped with functional fire safety systems, including sprinklers and alarms, to protect against fire risks associated with our bedding materials.

Additionally, we implement a CCTV surveillance system to monitor both sales and storage areas, enhancing our security measures. Employee training on theft prevention and inventory management is conducted annually, reinforcing our commitment to operational compliance and customer assurance. Dreamy Duvets & Blissful Bedding is dedicated to providing a safe, welcoming environment where customers can find their ideal bath and bedding solutions.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities related to high-susceptibility items, ensuring that less than 10% of our direct retail sales stem from such products. We confirm that we do not directly import products for retail sale, and that our functional fire suppression systems and fire alarms are both present and well-maintained. Additionally, regular inventory audits are conducted and documented to uphold our commitment to compliance.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, we experienced water damage due to a malfunctioning air conditioning unit. The estimated cost for repairs and inventory losses amounted to $2,500. The claim has been submitted and is currently under review with our insurance carrier.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, grade 1, UL-rated for fire and burglary protection
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system installed with coverage for sales and storage areas, and regular employee training on theft prevention provided annually.
